text.aria-label: Subtitle text '13 Primaries, 156 series-months, July 2025 to June 2026 (experiment 48) Dot: mean gap in flagged minus unflagged months. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months. Positive: weekly refits gain more where the flag is true. Zero: no difference. Intervals re-draw months only, with the series fixed.'
text.tspan: Dot: mean gap in flagged minus unflagged months.
Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months.
Positive: weekly refits gain more where the flag is true. Zero: no difference.
Intervals re-draw months only, with the series fixed.
